title: Roasted Strawberry Gelato
changes_from_base: Oven-roasted strawberries blended into a cornflour-set milk base replace the pistachio milk; no egg yolks.
summary: Roasting the strawberries concentrates their flavour, so even frozen or out-of-season berries make a deep, jammy pink gelato.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Roast
steps.text: Heat the oven to 200 °C. Toss the strawberries with the 60 g sugar in the roasting tin and roast for 20-25 min, until soft and sitting in a syrupy red juice. Cool slightly.

steps.title: Base
steps.text: Whisk the cornflour with 60 ml of the milk. Bring the rest of the milk, the cream, 70 g sugar and salt to a simmer, whisk in the slurry and cook for 3 min until lightly thickened.

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Blend the strawberries and every bit of their juice with the hot milk base until smooth.

steps.title: Chill
steps.text: Pour into the bowl over iced water, stir until cool, then cover and chill for at least 4 h.

steps.title: Churn
steps.text: Stir in the lemon juice and churn for 20-25 min.

steps.title: Freeze
steps.text: Pack into the container and freeze for at least 3 h; soften in the fridge for 15 min before scooping.

tips: Frozen strawberries roast well; add 5 min to the time.
Scrape every bit of syrup out of the tin; that is where the flavour is.
Serve with a few extra roasted strawberries spooned on top.
safety: Don't taste the raw dough or batter: raw flour and raw egg aren't safe to eat until baked.
storage: Keep covered with baking paper pressed on the surface in the freezer for up to 2 weeks. Soften for 10-15 min in the fridge before scooping.
